plan.notes: Source: Adams State University official 'Bachelor of Science in Biology, Cellular and Molecular Biology Emphasis, Suggested 4-Year Plan' degree map (PDF linked from the official Bachelor's Degree Maps page), hand-transcribed 2026-09-30. RANGE DISCLOSURES: the map gives credit ranges for three slots — Fall Year 3 '400-level Biology courses or Gen Ed (3-4)', Spring Year 4 '400-level Biology courses (4)' is fixed, 'Gen Ed or electives (6-9)', and Fall Year 3 header '15-16' / Spring Year 4 header '14-17'. This file models the LOWER bound of each range (3, 6), giving a plan total of 122; the map's own maximum is 126. CHEM 402 Biochemistry II is marked '(recommended)' in the map and is modeled as an optional choice slot. Map notes: '#' courses must be taken in the semester indicated to finish in 4 years; MATH 106/107 may shift but must precede physics; MATH 205 must be taken spring of sophomore year; pre-med students should take SOC 201 and PSYC 101 before the MCAT. The map lists no prerequisites.
